meta.project: TSU Collegiate Academic Portal & Campus Services

product_overview: A unified Android campus portal for TSU Main and Lucinda that gives students, faculty, and staff quick access to shuttle booking, canteen pre-ordering, print job submission, and department merchandise shopping. The home dashboard serves as a fast launchpad to these campus services while preserving the selected campus context.
core_goals: Let users quickly navigate from the campus hub to the right campus service
Allow users to book a shuttle seat and receive a boarding pass
Allow users to pre-order canteen items and track order progress
Allow users to submit a print job and receive pickup details
Allow users to browse and checkout department merchandise

features.name: Campus Hub Dashboard
features.description: A central launchpad where users choose their active campus and navigate to the main campus services.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the campus dashboard -> Select Main Campus or Lucinda Campus -> See the dashboard context update for the chosen campus -> Open a service card to navigate to that service
Navigate to / -> View the dashboard tiles -> Open a service card for Shuttle -> Arrive at the shuttle booking screen
Navigate to / -> View the dashboard tiles -> Open a service card for Canteen -> Arrive at the canteen ordering screen
Navigate to / -> View the dashboard tiles -> Open a service card for Print -> Arrive at the print submission screen
Navigate to / -> View the dashboard tiles -> Open a service card for Merch -> Arrive at the merchandise store

features.name: Shuttle Booking
features.description: Users select a shuttle direction, choose a seat, and confirm a campus shuttle booking to receive a boarding pass.
user_flows: Navigate to /shuttle -> Toggle shuttle route direction -> Select an available seat -> Confirm the booking -> See the generated QR boarding pass ticket
Navigate to /shuttle -> Toggle shuttle route direction -> Select an available seat -> Confirm the booking -> Continue to /shuttle/ticket -> See ticket details and boarding pass information
Navigate to /shuttle -> Attempt to confirm booking without selecting a seat -> See an input validation error
Navigate to /shuttle -> Toggle shuttle route direction -> Choose a different direction -> Select an available seat -> Confirm the booking -> See the ticket generated for the selected route

features.name: Canteen Ordering
features.description: Users add food items to a cart, review pricing, place an order, and track the live preparation status.
user_flows: Navigate to /canteen -> Add an item to the cart -> Add more items as desired -> View subtotal and total cost -> Place the order -> Continue to /canteen/tracker -> See the live order status tracker
Navigate to /canteen -> Add an item to the cart -> Remove an item from the cart -> View the updated subtotal and total cost -> Place the order -> See the order confirmation state
Navigate to /canteen -> Add multiple items to the cart -> View the running subtotal and total cost -> Place the order -> See the order move into the tracker status view
Navigate to /canteen/tracker -> View the current order status -> Observe the live preparation progress

features.name: Print Job Submission
features.description: Users choose a print partner, enter print job details, configure output options, and submit the job to receive a generated PIN.
user_flows: Navigate to /print -> Select a print partner -> Enter the number of pages -> Choose grayscale or color mode -> Toggle duplex printing if needed -> Submit the print job -> See the generated PIN in a modal
Navigate to /print -> Select a print partner -> Enter the number of pages -> Choose grayscale or color mode -> Submit the print job -> See the generated PIN for pickup and release
Navigate to /print -> Select a print partner -> Enter the number of pages -> Toggle duplex printing -> Submit the print job -> See the print job summary and generated PIN

features.name: Merch Store Checkout
features.description: Users filter merchandise by organization, favorite items, choose a size, add items to cart, and complete checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /merch -> Click an organization filter chip -> Browse the filtered product catalog -> Select a product -> Choose a size in the modal -> Add the item to cart -> Checkout from the bottom drawer -> See the success modal

Navigate to /merch -> Click an organization filter chip -> Click the heart on a product to favorite it -> Select a product -> Choose a size in the modal -> Add the item to cart -> Checkout from the bottom drawer -> See the success confirmation
Navigate to /merch -> Click + on a product card -> Choose a size in the modal -> Add the item to cart -> Checkout from the bottom drawer -> See the success modal

user_interactions: Click Main Campus or Lucinda Campus buttons
Click on service cards to navigate

See generated QR boarding pass ticket

user_interactions: Select Library Fleet or Tech Center
